text: It's a small clinic that I didn't notice until I found it on the map. This place is amazing! The dentist is so attentive. He told me that brushing back and forth, left and right, isn't the correct way to brush, causing gum damage and future tooth erosion. He taught me the proper brushing technique in detail – something no other dentist has ever told me. It was a real eye-opener. He's a highly ethical dentist, which made me so happy and impressed. I really felt like it was both "treatment" and "care." I came for a scaling, and his touch was incredibly gentle – 1000/10! I was treated by a male dentist, and I even used my social security insurance. The price was normal, but totally worth it.
